findings.text: the command label reads "<61 files importing reckon.crew.runs>" while the arm ran the same 50-file list as the base arm (the worker transcript records n_files=50 and both arms collected 585 tests), so the log misstates the set it ran.

the head arm names rev=cce1f3a8, the base commit, because its edit was still uncommitted when the arm ran (log mtime 01:55:59, commit 70c1c3df at 02:13:50), so the log cannot tie its own arm to a revision containing the change.

this arm log, and its base sibling at logs/base-named-test.log:1, carry no first line naming the tree, the revision and the command, the header the node's own evidence contract requires of a gate log (prompt.txt:121).

the landing note's effect claim, "a coordinator reading the watch surface had no route to the run", reads a wake route out of a tuple with no production consumer (WATCH_ATTENTION_STATES at reckon/crew/runs.py:2420 is read only by tests) while the runtime route ticker.NEEDS_ACTION to recovery.FLEET_BLOCKED_STATES already carried launch-failed at base, so what landed is the vocabulary invariant the named test asserts rather than a changed delivery path.

item_verdicts.diff: read the two commits against base cce1f3a8; 70c1c3df carries the one tuple entry plus the evidence record, figure and plan note, and 5ce30907 records the landing, so the product diff is one line.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the done_when naming tests/test_crew.py::test_every_live_state_has_one_fleet_bucket_and_an_attention_route; both arm logs record the asserted measure, red at base (logs/base-named-test.log:40, "Extra items in the left set: 'launch-failed'") and green at head (logs/head-named-test.log:2).
item_verdicts.goal: read the node goal "A launch-failed run is an attention state a follower wakes on" (prompt.txt:25) against the diff, and the landed change is exactly that: reckon/crew/runs.py:2424 now names launch-failed in WATCH_ATTENTION_STATES.
item_verdicts.manifest: read it with its five named logs; the named-test arms and the negative control match the logs and prove the measure, but the import-set arm records carry the metadata defects named in the findings below.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the four declared write paths against the diff, and all five changed paths lie inside them (reckon/crew/runs.py, the evidence archive, the figure and its generator, the plan), with no test file touched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_crew.py:3295 asserts recovery.FLEET_BLOCKED_STATES, derived from ticker.NEEDS_ACTION, is a subset of runs.WATCH_ATTENTION_STATES, two independently sourced vocabularies, and the negative control log shows removing the entry reddens it.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_crew.py:3295 is recorded red at base (logs/base-named-test.log:40) and green at head (logs/head-named-test.log:2), so the gate measures the done_when, but the import-set arm metadata named in the findings keeps the surrounding record from being fully trustworthy.
justifications.fit: the entry joins the surrounding tuple at reckon/crew/runs.py:2420-2431 in its existing order and introduces no forbidden identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/runs.py:2424 adds launch-failed to WATCH_ATTENTION_STATES, which is the attention vocabulary the goal names and the exact change the named test measures.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the declared write paths, and the product diff is the single tuple entry at reckon/crew/runs.py:2424.
